title: Headings that condense line by line through an SVG goo filter
summary: SplitText lines after fonts, each given its own `<filter>` of `feGaussianBlur` into an `feColorMatrix` alpha threshold (`18 × α − 7`): `stdDeviation` from `.32 em` of the font size to `0` over `1.1 s` `power3.out`, lines `.12 s` apart, the matrix relaxed to identity over the blur's last `.45 s`, each line's filter and `<filter>` node removed as it lands and the split reverted when the heading has, so it ends as its authored markup; once per heading at `top 85%`, `autoSplit` rebuilds the filters mid-reveal; a `.4 s` opacity fade with no split and no filter under reduced motion, plain text in the static tier
variants: per-line blur and alpha threshold relaxed to identity, filter removed on landing (full tier)
opacity fade only, never split or filtered (reduced)
plain text from the first frame (static)
condense out again: the same timeline reversed with the threshold restored first (README)
